how: coax/web/tool.sh coax/perf/compile-times.coax --write: coax check APP --timings-json with an empty library-check cache; whole milliseconds
note: Recorded while other builds kept the load average between 50 and 130 on 18 cores; an idle run is about half these times (Everglade 1071 s total, 1050 s authority, at load 9). Rerecord with --write on a quiet machine.
